mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and requires strict pregnancy prevention; atomoxetine may impair judgment/behavior in susceptible patients, potentially compromising adherence to contraceptive requirements and iPLEDGE program compliance.
action: Ensure robust contraception and iPLEDGE enrollment if both drugs are necessary; monitor psychiatric status closely as atomoxetine may worsen mood symptoms that isotretinoin can also cause.
